claims: The 98th Academy Awards took place in March 2026.
Paul Thomas Anderson won Best Director for One Battle After Another at the 98th Academy Awards.
Paul Thomas Anderson won Best Adapted Screenplay for One Battle After Another at the 98th Academy Awards.
One Battle After Another won Best Picture at the 98th Academy Awards.
Paul Thomas Anderson won Best Picture as producer for One Battle After Another.
Paul Thomas Anderson's wins at the 98th Academy Awards were his first Oscars.
Paul Thomas Anderson had 14 previous unsuccessful nominations.
One Battle After Another is adapted from Thomas Pynchon's Vineland.
Sean Penn won Best Supporting Actor for One Battle After Another.
Paul Thomas Anderson was nominated for Best Director for There Will Be Blood in 2008.
Paul Thomas Anderson was nominated for Best Director for Phantom Thread in 2018.
Paul Thomas Anderson was nominated for Best Director for Licorice Pizza in 2022.
Paul Thomas Anderson was nominated for Best Original/Adapted Screenplay for Boogie Nights in 1998.
Paul Thomas Anderson was nominated for Best Original/Adapted Screenplay for Magnolia in 2000.
Paul Thomas Anderson was nominated for Best Original/Adapted Screenplay for Inherent Vice in 2015.
Paul Thomas Anderson was nominated for Best Picture for There Will Be Blood.
Paul Thomas Anderson was nominated for Best Picture for Phantom Thread.
Paul Thomas Anderson was nominated for Best Picture for Licorice Pizza.
